title: Returning Home After the Storm
narrative_summary: A first responder comes home changed after a long deployment, faces the quiet of ordinary life, struggles to reconnect, reaches a turning point through a small act of service, breaks through into honest presence with family, and settles into a quieter resolve to keep showing up.
style_brief: Cinematic ambient-orchestral instrumental; warm low strings, restrained piano, distant percussion; intimate then expansive; no vocals
